posting.title: Product Manager - Project Intern (Global Monetization Product and Technology) - 2027 Start
posting.description:
Responsibilities
The Ads Platform and Interfaces teams build the advertiser-facing products, platforms, and services businesses use to create, manage, and optimize advertising campaigns on TikTok. Advertisers and internal product teams depend on these systems for seamless, reliable experiences at global scale.

We work on complex challenges across scalability, system performance, platform reliability, and rapidly evolving customer needs, on systems where campaign delivery and business outcomes ride on how well they perform.

You will shape the core advertising experience, on work with measurable impact for millions of businesses worldwide.

The TikTok Marketing API team is responsible for building and managing the foundational programmatic infrastructure for TikTok’s advertising ecosystem.
Our scope includes API, MCP, partner integrations, and technology partner and agency co-development. We build the products and platform capabilities that allow developers, partners, agencies, and advertisers to programmatically create, manage, optimize, and scale advertising workflows on TikTok.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Responsibilities:
- Translate business needs into clear, actionable product requirements. Partner with business and product stakeholders to clarify objectives, scope, and success criteria; develop PRDs; and align cross-functional teams and engineering on requirements, dependencies, and delivery milestones to keep execution on track.
- Support product planning and execution for ads integration and plugins capabilities across APIs, SDKs, developer tooling, documentation, sandbox environments, debugging workflows, and overall developer experience.
- Partner closely with engineering to help design and launch developer-facing product improvements, including API capabilities, authentication flows, schemas, validation systems, testing tools, observability, and integration support infrastructure.
- Learn and synthesize the needs of developers, technology partners, agencies, advertisers, and internal teams; help translate those needs into clear product requirements and prioritized opportunities.
- Assist with product discovery and analysis across external partners and internal stakeholders, including workflow research, competitive analysis, technical feasibility assessment, and feedback synthesis.
- Collaborate with partner-facing teams to identify integration pain points, product gaps, adoption blockers, and opportunities to make TikTok’s platform easier and more reliable for developers and partners to use.
- Help define and track success metrics for developer platform products, including API adoption, integration quality, developer satisfaction, documentation quality, tooling usage, and partner impact.
- Work across TikTok’s API surfaces, including Marketing APIs, Organic APIs, Business Messaging APIs, and emerging automation-oriented or AI-enabled platform capabilities.
- Support cross-functional alignment on scoped product priorities, user needs, implementation tradeoffs, and launch readiness.
- Create clear product documents, requirements, analyses, and internal enablement materials to support team alignment and execution.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications: 
- Currently in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related fields.
- Academic background in computer science or related fields, with technical experience or project work preferred
- Interest in product management, developer platforms, APIs, SDKs, integrations, automation products, or workflow systems, demonstrated through coursework, projects, research, or prior internship experience.
- Strong technical aptitude and comfort learning about APIs, authentication, request/response structures, integration patterns, developer workflows, and system interactions.
- Ability to break down ambiguous user, partner, or business needs into structured problem statements, product ideas, and actionable next steps.
- Able to intern for 3 months or longer; candidates available to work 5 days a week are preferred.
- Must be able to commit to a 12-week full-time work period during winter 

By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy

posting.description:
Responsibilities
About the Team 
Our team builds a global copyright protection platform that translates legal requirements, business policies, and operational workflows into reliable and scalable systems. The platform supports complaint intake, regional routing, human review, enforcement, notifications, creator appeals, rightsholder rebuttals, and proactive content identification.

We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth.
Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.
Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

You will work on complex event-driven systems and multi-region distributed architectures, addressing real-world challenges in consistency, idempotency, cross-region routing, reliability, and compliance.

Responsibilities
- Participate in the architecture design and development of core backend services for the copyright protection platform, writing high-quality Go code across modules including complaint intake, audit scheduling, enforcement execution, and appeal management.
- Contribute to the design and implementation of event-driven architecture, building high-availability event flow pipelines based on EventBus/MQ that ensure reliable delivery and eventual consistency across cross-service business workflows.
- Design, optimize, and maintain databases (MySQL/NoSQL) supporting efficient storage and querying at billion-scale data volumes, ensuring data integrity and consistency.
- Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and RPC interfaces, ensuring efficient and secure data exchange between front-end applications, internal platforms, and external systems.
- Participate in system design and data synchronization strategies for multi-DC (Multi-Data Center / Multi-VGeo) architecture, solving distributed challenges such as cross-region replication lag and read-after-write consistency.
- Monitor and optimize system performance, identify and resolve potential bottlenecks, and improve system throughput and response speed.
- Quickly respond to and resolve production environment issues, ensuring system stability and business continuity.
- Collaborate closely with product managers, front-end engineers, algorithm teams, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality and on-time project delivery.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor's/ Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. 
- Proficient in at least one backend programming language such as Go, Java, or C++;
- Familiar with common database technologies such as MySQL, Redis, and MongoDB; understanding of index optimization and basic performance tuning.
- Understanding of RESTful API design and development
- Familiar with Linux-based operating systems and common commands; basic Shell scripting ability.
- Strong problem-solving and logical thinking abilities, passion for new technologies, and a quick learning ability. Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a strong team-oriented mindset.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Understanding of microservices architecture and related technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, etc.
- Experience in developing large-scale distributed systems; understanding of message queues (e.g., Kafka, EventBus), distributed transactions, and eventual consistency.
- Familiarity with Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) or publish-subscribe patterns, with relevant hands-on experience.
- Interest in or knowledge of copyright protection, content safety, or multimedia processing (e.g., audio/video fingerprinting, content matching).
- Knowledge of Machine Learning Engineering (MLE) concepts and practices, including model training, deployment, and evaluation.
- Open-source contributions, technical blog posts, or programming awards are a plus.
- Go experience is a plus.
- Familiarity with RPC frameworks (e.g., Thrift, gRPC) is a plus.

posting.description:

The TikTok Professionally Generated Content (PGC) team builds the product and platform capabilities that help professional creators grow, create, monetize, and expand their reach. We deepen support for high-value verticals such as music and short drama, enriching the range of content on the platform so users find high-quality, diverse professional work.

Scaling a diverse, sustainable professional content ecosystem across global markets requires building for different content formats and business models, aligning creator incentives with audience value, and upholding copyright and content integrity standards.

You will shape the creator support system and the content ecosystem, raising the quality of what people discover on TikTok.

About the Team
The TikTok Eng-PGC-OGC&Creator Strategy-Subscription&Payment team builds technology that helps TikTok identify, incentivize, and grow high-quality professionally generated content while enabling creators to build sustainable careers on the platform. We develop the strategy and engineering infrastructure that turns creator and platform goals into scalable monetization products, product experiences, and governance solutions.

The team's core business is In-App Purchase (IAP), which covers PGC creator subscriptions and paid short drama. We build the backend systems behind these products, including purchase and entitlement flows, subscription lifecycle management, content unlocking, and revenue settlement, so that creators and content partners can monetize premium content directly with their audiences across global markets. We work at the intersection of large-scale backend engineering, creator strategy, monetization, and trust and safety. You will collaborate closely with Product, Data Science, Research, Design, Operations, and Trust and Safety teams to improve high-quality content supply, creator value, transparency, and the scalability of our creator ecosystem.

Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain backend services for TikTok PGC In-App Purchase (IAP) products, including PGC creator subscriptions, paid short drama, creator and consumer experience, governance, and payout.
- Build reliable and scalable systems that translate product and creator strategy into configurable purchase, entitlement, subscription, experimentation, governance, and financial workflows.
- Partner with Product, Data Science, Research, Operations, and Trust and Safety teams to understand creator and business needs, evaluate trade-offs, and deliver well-designed technical solutions.
- Improve the correctness, performance, availability, observability, and data integrity of large-scale, data-intensive systems through testing, monitoring, code reviews, and technical documentation.
- Contribute to technical design and implementation, take ownership of projects from development through launch, and use data and feedback to drive ongoing product and system iteration.

- Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, computer networks, operating systems, and database fundamentals.
- Familiarity with relational databases and caching technologies such as MySQL and Redis, including basic indexing and performance optimization concepts.
- Strong problem-solving skills, learning agility, ownership, and the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively in a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to high-concurrency or data-intensive systems and an understanding of reliability, observability, and data consistency.

posting.description:
Responsibilities
The Traffic Infrastructure (TI) team leverages unified platform capabilities to manage global edge infrastructure (both self-built and third-party), providing standardized, compliant, scalable, and cost-effective traffic infrastructure capabilities for edge services. Our vision is to build a global edge traffic infrastructure platform and become the long-term cornerstone of ByteDance's global edge business in terms of scale, performance, and cost.
As an Intern, you will join a team of experienced infrastructure engineers who will mentor you throughout your internship. You will work on real production systems that serve global edge traffic at massive scale, gaining hands-on exposure to cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, and networking from day one.

What You Will Do:
- Assist in the design, development, and operation of infrastructure components for global edge PoPs (e.g., Kubernetes/control plane, virtualization/containers, Ingress/Gateway), with close guidance from senior engineers, focusing on performance, reliability, and security.
- Participate in the delivery of cloud-native features — from requirements and implementation to testing and rollout — while learning our engineering best practices.
- Help build observability and troubleshooting tooling (metrics/logs/tracing/profiling) and contribute to automation that improves incident response efficiency.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications: 
- Currently pursuing an Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Solid foundation in software engineering fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, operating systems, computer networks).
- Programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, C or Rust, demonstrated through coursework, personal projects, or open-source contributions.
- Familiarity with Linux and basic understanding of containers, distributed systems, or networking concepts.
- Strong problem-solving skills, a growth mindset, ownership, and eagerness to learn in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications: 
- Prior internship, co-op, or research experience related to backend/systems development, cloud-native technologies, or infrastructure.
- Hands-on exposure to containers and Kubernetes through coursework, side projects, or internships (e.g., deploying applications, basic cluster operations, service discovery, Ingress/Gateway).

- Deeper Linux knowledge (kernel, scheduling, TCP/IP, routing, iptables/nftables) gained through projects or self-study.
- Coursework, projects, or curiosity around CDN, live streaming, RTC, or other edge/traffic-intensive architectures.

posting.description:
Responsibilities
The Applied Machine Learning Ark team combines system engineering and machine learning to develop and operate Large Language Model (LLM) service platforms that offer businesses Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) solutions, serving both large model providers and downstream users. The US team drives the design, development, and operation of MaaS solutions across the US and international markets outside mainland China. We are building full-stack, end-to-end solutions spanning text and multimodal LLM algorithms, LLM training/fine-tuning/inference frameworks, prompt engineering, model alignment, and intelligent agent systems. Beyond model serving, we operate large-scale log analytics pipelines that process massive volumes of invocation logs from text models, multimodal models, and agent systems — extracting usage patterns, quality signals, and actionable insights to inform model improvement, system optimization, and product decisions through continuous, data-driven feedback loops. We are actively seeking talented engineers and researchers specializing in Large Language Models and AI Agent systems to join our dynamic team.

Responsibilities:
- Build evaluation systems for image and video models/agents, covering generation quality, instruction following, multimodal understanding, and safety.
- Develop automated metrics and model-based evaluators, and design reproducible human evaluation protocols.
- Design and develop video generation/debugging agents that orchestrate multi-step creative workflows.
- Build large-scale image and video data pipelines, and turn evaluation findings into model and product improvements.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications: 
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related field.
- Solid foundation in deep learning and computer vision, including generative modeling fundamentals.
- Practical experience in at least one of: visual generation, multimodal LLMs, video understanding, or visual quality assessment.
- Strong Python skills and proficiency with PyTorch or an equivalent framework, or multimodal evaluation framework.
- Demonstrated research or engineering ability through publications, substantial projects, internships, or open-source work.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Hands-on experience with modern visual generation stacks, including diffusion-based models and their post-training.
